share.token_hint_explained: Only a hash of each token is stored, so a link cannot be recovered after creation - create a new one instead.
share.expires_hint: The date is optional. Without it the link works until you revoke it; with it the link stops opening at the end of that day (UTC).

settings.anonymize_ip_hint: Only the network part of an address is used, and never stored in clear text.
settings.cron_hint: Point a cron job or an external cron service at this URL every five minutes. It refreshes the daily reports, prunes old raw data and keeps the IP database up to date.
settings.exclude_bots_hint: Drop hits from crawlers, uptime monitors and command line clients.
settings.geoip_hint: The import runs in batches, so it also works on hostings with a short execution limit.
settings.maintenance_cron_rotated: A new cron secret was generated - update your cron URL.
settings.maintenance_purged: Removed {pageviews} pageviews and {visits} visits. Aggregated reports were kept.
settings.password_error_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
settings.password_error_too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
settings.password_error_too_weak: That password is too easy to guess.
settings.respect_dnt_hint: Browsers that send DNT are not counted at all.
settings.retention_hint: Daily reports are kept forever; only the individual pageviews are pruned.
settings.security_installer_locked: The installer is locked, so nobody can reinstall over your instance. Deleting the folder is still recommended.
settings.session_timeout_hint: A visit ends after this much inactivity.
settings.subtitle: Language, privacy, data retention and maintenance.
settings.title: Settings
settings.store_ip_hint: Off by default. When enabled, the visitor log shows the address every session came from.
settings.store_ip_warning: IP addresses are personal data. Turning this on means you need a legal basis for the processing and must mention it in your privacy policy; shorten the retention window while it is on. The change is written to the activity log.
settings.migration_none: The database schema is already up to date.
settings.geoip_update: Download the newest database and import
settings.geoip_update_hint: Fetches the current DB-IP Lite country release and imports it. New visitors are resolved with it immediately; hits that were already recorded keep the country they were counted with.
settings.geoip_reimport_hint: Imports the snapshot that ships with the project (dated {date}). Useful after clearing the table by hand, or when the download is blocked by the hosting.
settings.retention_cnil: Above 25 months the CNIL recommendations for consent-exempt audience measurement no longer apply.

security.install_dir_present: The /install/ folder is still on the server. Delete it now: while it exists, your instance is one bug away from being reinstalled by somebody else.

error.csrf_body: The form expired or came from another site. Please go back and try again.
error.database_body: The database is not reachable. Check the credentials in config/config.php and that the database server is running.
error.forbidden_body: Your account does not have access to this page.
error.method_body: This page does not accept that kind of request.
error.not_found_body: The page you asked for does not exist.
error.server_body: Something went wrong on the server. The details were written to the application log.

install.admin_body: This account has full access: it manages websites, client accounts and settings.
install.admin_password_hint: At least {count} characters. Use a password manager.
install.config_not_writable: Could not write config/config.php. Give the config folder write permissions and try again.
install.db_error_prefix: The table prefix may only contain letters, digits and underscores.
install.db_error_required: Database name and user are required.
install.db_name_hint: The database has to exist already; tables are created inside it.
install.db_prefix_hint: Use a prefix if the database is shared with another application.
install.done_body: PlotBird Analytics is installed and already collects data. Paste the tracking code into your website and watch the first visitors arrive.
install.geoip_body: The IP database is already on your server - it only has to be imported into the database once. The import runs in batches, so it also works on hostings with a short execution limit. Without it every visitor is reported as an unknown country.
install.geoip_missing: The bundled database file was not found in data/geoip/. You can upload it later on the settings page.
install.geoip_skip_hint: If you skip this, every visitor shows an unknown country until you import the database on the settings page.
install.language_body: The language was pre-selected from your browser. You can change it at any time.
install.locked_body: This instance is already installed. For safety the wizard refuses to run again, because a second run would let anybody take over your data.
install.next_steps_cron: Add the maintenance cron job so daily reports stay fresh:
install.next_steps_tracker: Paste the tracking code into the <head> of every page you want to measure.
install.next_steps_users: Create client accounts and assign websites to them on the Users page.
install.pretty_urls_hint: Requires mod_rewrite (Apache). Turn it off if your links end up in 404s.
install.pretty_urls_unknown: Could not detect mod_rewrite; leave it on unless links break.
install.remove_body: The installer stays reachable while the folder exists. Delete it from your hosting file manager or over FTP.
install.remove_ftp: On shared hosting: file manager → the project folder → delete the install directory.
install.remove_locked: Even if you never delete it, the wizard is locked and cannot reinstall your instance.
install.requirement_geoip_download: optional, only needed to download a newer IP database
install.requirements_hint: Fix the red items above, then check again.
install.schema_body: The tables below will be created in your database and the configuration file will be written.
install.schema_done_body: All tables were created and the configuration file was generated.
install.schema_missing: install/schema.sql was not found - the download seems incomplete.
install.schema_warning: Existing tables with the same prefix are kept; the installer only creates what is missing.
install.site_body: Add the website you want to measure. You can always add more later.
install.site_or_skip: or skip this step and add it later.
install.snippet_body: Paste this single line into the <head> of every page you want to measure.
install.subtitle: Self-hosted, cookie-free web analytics
install.title: PlotBird Analytics setup

install.tracker_url_hint: Nothing yet? Reload your website in another tab, then check again.
install.tracker_waiting: No hit received yet. Open your website in another tab and give it a few seconds.
install.geoip_skip: Skip - I will do it later in the settings
